improvements.rationale: These meta tags improve search engine visibility by clearly communicating what Gideon offers within the 155-character limit for descriptions. The OG tags ensure professional previews when shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter—critical channels for reaching business owners and traders. Mentioning the free trial removes friction and encourages clicks. All claims stay within provided site context without inventing statistics.

improvements.suggestion:
Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant

Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a professional workspace built for business owners and traders. Try three searches free, no card required.
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately names the product and its purpose, while the subheading highlights three core value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) and removes friction by emphasizing the free trial with no payment commitment. Direct and benefit-driven copy reduces bounce and increases trial starts.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to choose a membership plan to continue accessing Gideon. Memberships start at just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual plans saving you 30 percent. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own dedicated workspace.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition from free to paid, it reduces uncertainty, sets expectations, and positions the membership as a natural next step rather than a barrier. Including pricing and the annual discount reinforces value without pressure.
